summary: Implemented T026: a complete, idempotent PoolKey registry that accepts pools by target token, by full V4 PoolKey, or by PoolId; explicit rejection of any 20-byte address supplied as a pool identity; a research-universe membership collection kept disjoint from the single active execution pool; and the configuration-side ResearchMemberConfig collection wired into RootConfig with strict validation. New code: src/robinhood_lp/discovery/onboarding.py (PoolOnboarder, OnboardingPath, AddressRejectionRecord, PoolIdentityNotFoundError, PoolIdentityMismatchError, PoolIdentityRejectionError, entry_path_for); src/robinhood_lp/discovery/research_universe.py (ResearchUniverse, ResearchMember, PoolRole, PoolMembershipView, build_membership_view, DuplicateResearchMemberError, UnknownResearchMemberError, EmptyBlockRangeError). Modifications: PoolRecord gains an entry_paths field; RootConfig gains research_universe with strict duplicate and chain-reference validation; ResearchMemberConfig is the strict pydantic model for a research member. New tests: tests/test_pool_onboarding.py (27 tests), tests/test_research_universe.py (38 tests), tests/test_research_universe_config.py (18 tests). All 83 new tests pass; full suite is 1238 passed / 6 skipped / 1 pre-existing T012 forge blocker failed (unrelated to T026). Ruff check + format clean; mypy strict clean on src and the three new test files.
